A '''weeliu nut''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. The crew of the ''[[Smoking Blaster]]'' attempted to smuggle illegal [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] [[Logic matrix/Legends|logic matrixes]] from [[Syned]] to [[Cotellier/Legends|Cotellier]] in crates of weeliu nuts.
